about_the_game:
Pro Soccer Online is back and better than ever. Featuring a newer game engine, and built from the ground up, Pro Soccer Online 2 is a bigger and better version of the 1st one. It offers the same smooth, input based, physics driven gameplay, with lots of additional features and QOL improvements.

Some of the major features it offers are:

1) Better anti-cheat

Various cheats have been patched to provide a better, more consistent experience for players.

2) Ranked Modes

Ranked matchmaking for 5v5, 6v6 and 8v8 matches. You can play solo, party up with friends or even your whole team. It uses skill based matchmaking, an overall rating system, and leaderboards. You can earn coins by playing ranked modes and unlock customization items with them.

3) Custom Lobbies

Custom lobbies allow you to create non-ranked public or private matches with hosts who can control the matches and their settings. It's perfect for practicing for ranked modes, playing with a private group of friends and/or leagues and tournaments.

4) Multiplayer training

Practice with other players and/or friends in a public multiplayer training mode that also acts as a good way to meet and socialize with other players.

5) Enhanced player profiles

Each player has a viewable profile that contains information like their preferred region, mode and positions as well as their stats for each mode, and their personal achievements.

6) Enhanced team profiles

Teams can be created, customized and have Steam friends invited to it's roster. Similarly to player profiles, team profiles show details about their preferences for region, mode and formations as well as stats and achievements. 

7) Enhanced customization

Player and team customization is very improved from the 1st game. From different styles of clothing, hairstyles, shoes, accessories, team colors and patterns, there are a lot of options for how to customize your appearance and team to your exact liking. The cosmetics can be unlocked with coins, or Pro Points, a paid currency.

8) Discord communities

Discord communities have been a vital part of the 1st game and will continue to be a large part of the 2nd. Discord communities will provide a way to meet other players and/or teams. They will also be hosting official leagues and tournaments.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor at 2.5 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card for Windows
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
